policy: Preserve a contributing source author as Git Author; credit other included commit authors with Co-authored-by, and retain original source-declared co-author trailers. The coordinator remains Committer. PR openers, merge-only identities, excluded alternatives and transitive dependency authors are not substituted for actual contributing authors.
github_profile_limit: Original identities are preserved, including unlinked identities. GitHub profile/contribution attribution depends on email association and the eventual merge strategy; no email is invented or replaced with a guessed noreply address.

omitted_commits.reason: Merge-only commit; original implementation authors are credited from their contributing commits.
